19th February, 1937.

PRIVATE & CONFIDENTIAL.

J.W.Platt, Esq.,
Hongkong.

Dear Sir,

Wong Ya Jao.

I have been able to obtain a certain amount of
additional information which indicates that Wong Ya Jao
actually was murdered. Each street in Wuchow has a
headman and Mr. Ku knows the headman of the street
in which the murder was committed. This man states
quite definitely that Wong Ya Jao was buried by the
military the day after the murder on the opposite side
of the river just above the golf course.

A local police detective has also confirmed
that he was killed and states that the woman, who fled
from the house after the murder was committed, has
recently returned to fetch her children whom the
Public Safety Bureau had been looking after since her
disappearance.

It is also quite definite that Wong Ya Jao's
wife is still living in Wong Kuk Choh's house in Wuchow,
but the Military will not allow access to unauthorised
persons. It is difficult to know what interpretation
to put on this but my own idea is that there would not
be much point in their detaining her if he has not
been murdered and is still at large.

I do not expect to be able to get any further
information but it is just possible that we may be able
to get into touch with the wife. If so, I will let you
know.

Yours faithfully,

1937年2月19日。

私人且机密。

致：J.W. Platt 先生，
香港。

敬启者：

关于王亚樵（Wong Ya Jao）。

我已设法获取了一些额外信息，表明王亚樵确实已被谋杀。梧州的每条街道都有一名街长，顾先生认识发生谋杀案那条街道的街长。此人非常肯定地表示，王亚樵在谋杀案发生的第二天被军方埋葬在河对岸、高尔夫球场上游不远处。

一名当地警探也证实了他被杀的事实，并称那名在谋杀案发生后从屋内逃离的女子最近已回来接走她的孩子，这些孩子自她失踪以来一直由公安局照顾。

另外可以肯定的是，王亚樵的妻子仍住在梧州黄国祚（Wong Kuk Choh，音译）的家中，但军方不允许未经授权的人员进入。很难对此作何解释，但我个人的看法是，如果他没有被谋杀且仍在逃，他们扣留她并没有多大意义。

我不指望能获得更多情报，但我们有可能与其妻子取得联系。若有进展，我会通知您。

此致
敬礼

29th December, 1936.

Director of Criminal Intelligence,
Police Headquarters,
HONG KONG.

Sir,

With reference to your letter of the 23rd December,
concerning the murder of a certain Wong Ya Jao, at Wuchow,
Kwangsai, on the 21st November, I append an extract from a
letter received from the Manager of this Company in Wuchow,
giving details of the political connections and manner of
death of this Wong Ya Jao, which he believes to be reliable:-

"Wong Ya Jao was a native of Kwangsai and was
formerly a colonel in the Kwangsai Army. It is
said that Li Chai Sum personally engaged him as
head of a gang of assassins whose object was to
murder Wang Ching Wei. After they had failed, the
gang broke up and some months ago Wong Ya Jao came
to Wuchow ostensibly to obtain work. He lived in
a house belonging to Wong Kok Choh, the Governor
of Kwangsai, and was connected in some way with
Wuchow Military Headquarters, though whether he
had a definite job or not cannot be ascertained.
Li Chai Sum is then reported to have been afraid
that Wong Ya Jao would give away the plot to
assassinate Wang Ching Wei and it is possible that
Wong blackmailed Li. At all events Li Chai Sum
gave orders that he was to be murdered and this
was done as reported in the press on November 21st.

On the night of the murder Wong Ya Jao was
entertained to dinner by two officers of the Kwang-
sai Army, who got him very drunk and then induced
him to visit the house of a certain woman with
them. Shortly after their arrival there were three
shots and three people were seen leaving the house
in a hurry directly afterwards. There seems no
doubt that the murder was carried out by Kwangsai
Army officers, particularly as only the Military
may carry guns, a law which is very strictly enforced.

The Wuchow Magistrate sent men to examine the
corpse on the following day but they found the house
where the murder took place in the control of the
Military who refused to let them enter. Shortly
afterwards the Public Safety Bureau was instructed
by the Military to drop their investigations into
the matter."

I have etc., etc.,
Sd. J.V. Platt.

先生：

关于阁下12月23日来信，提及11月21日在广西梧州发生的一起名为王亚樵（Wong Ya Jao）者的谋杀案，现附录本公司梧州经理来信的摘录，其中详细说明了该王亚樵的政治联系及死亡方式，他认为这些信息是可靠的：—

“王亚樵是广西人，曾任广西军上校。据说李济深（Li Chai Sum，音译）亲自雇佣他作为刺客团伙的头目，其目的是刺杀汪精卫。行动失败后，该团伙解散，几个月前王亚樵来到梧州，表面上是为了找工作。他住在广西省主席黄绍竑（Wong Kok Choh，音译）的一所房子里，并与梧州军事司令部有某种联系，尽管无法确定他是否有明确的职务。随后据报道，李济深担心王亚樵会泄露刺杀汪精卫的阴谋，也有可能是王亚樵勒索李济深。总之，李济深下令将其谋杀，此事正如11月21日报纸所报道的那样执行了。

在谋杀案发生的当晚，两名广西军军官宴请王亚樵，将他灌得酩酊大醉，然后诱使他与他们一起去拜访一名女子。他们到达后不久，响起了三声枪响，随后立即看到三个人匆忙离开那所房子。毫无疑问，谋杀是由广西军军官实施的，特别是因为只有军人可以携带枪支，而这一法律执行得非常严格。

梧州地方法官次日派人去查验尸体，但他们发现发生谋杀案的房屋由军方控制，军方拒绝让他们进入。不久之后，公安局奉军方指示停止对此事的调查。”

此致等，
签署：J.V. Platt。

WONG AH CHIAO REPORTED TO BE IN SHANGHAI

Sian is now the center of red
activities. Wong Ah Chiao, who is reported to be the
leader of a professional assassination gang which was
directly responsible for the Nakayama, the Kayau and
the Taminato murder cases, is very active in Sian. Soon
after General Yang Yong Tai was murdered at Hankow, it
was reported that Wong Ah Chiao had also been murdered,
but the report has been found to be false. Following
the Sian incident, Wong Ah Chiao proceeded to Sian and
secured an interview with General Yu Hsueh Choong and
General Yang Hu Chen. Since then he has become active.
Wong Ah Chiao plans to come to
Shanghai to restart anti-Japanese terrorist acts as soon
as Mr. Wang Ching Wei arrives in Shanghai. According
to one source of information, Wong Ah Chiao has already
arrived here, for recently it was reported that a member
of a professional assassination gang belonging to Chang
Hsueh Liang's party had secretly arrived in Shanghai.
The authorities are making an investigation into these
reports.

据报道王亚樵在上海

西安现在是红色活动的中心。据报道，王亚樵是一个职业刺客团伙的头目，该团伙直接负责中山、霞飞和大连南路（Taminato，音译，或指特定地点/案件）谋杀案，他在西安非常活跃。杨永泰将军在汉口被刺后不久，曾有报道称王亚樵也被谋杀，但后来发现该报道不实。西安事变后，王亚樵前往西安，并获准会见于学忠将军和杨虎城将军。此后他便变得活跃起来。
王亚樵计划一旦汪精卫先生抵达上海，便前来上海重启反日恐怖活动。据一个消息来源称，王亚樵已经抵达此处，因为最近有报道称，属于张学良派系的一名职业刺客团伙成员已秘密抵达上海。当局正在对这些报告进行调查。

Subject Reported Assassination of Wong Yao Jao.

Made by and Forwarded by D.S.I. Coyne

According to reports emanating from Canton and appearing
in the local press, Wong Yao Jao (王亞樵) alleged leader of
the gang responsible for the attempt on the life of Mr. Wong
Ching Wei, was assassinated on Nov. 21, at Wuchow, Kwangsi
Province.

Chinese officials who have been asked whether this
report is authentic have stated that it is and one has gone
so far as to say that the reward offered for the arrest of
Wong has already been paid by Nanking to those responsible
for his death.

On the other hand, some persons interested in the
activities of Wong have expressed doubt concerning the veracity
of the report, pointing out that Wong would be kept out of the
reach of the agents of the Central Government.

Enquiries have now been set afoot in Wuchow with the
object of ascertaining whether any person was shot at the time
stated and if so, whether that person was Wong Yao Jao.

SUMMARY OF WANG YAH JAO
Dec. 12, 1936.
Wang Yah Jao (王亚樵), age about 50, native of
Anhwei, is widely known as a notorious assassin responsible
for a number of political murders. It is believed that
he has no political inclinations and that he has been
hired by a certain party or parties to commit acts of
terrorism. His activities, especially in recent years,
have been a constant menace to the Central Government
which at one time offered a reward of $100,000.00 for
his arrest.
Little is known of the early career of Wang Yah
Jao except that he was at one time a junior army officer
under General Feng Yu Hsiang. Although having received
less school education than his followers, some of whom
have had college education, he is, nevertheless, very
shrewd and has a good brain and all the qualities of
leadership. Wang Yah Jao first came to the notice of
the local police when the Shanghai National Labourers
Salvation Society, of which Wang Yah Jao was the
organizer and chairman, cabled a telegram to the
representative of the U.S.S.R. at Peking on November 7,
1923, congratulating him on the occasion of the
anniversary of his country's liberation and also inviting
him to come to Shanghai for the purpose of signing a
Sino-Soviet commercial treaty so as to promote the
friendship of the two nations. Only a few days later,
10.11.1923, Wang detailed his follower Lee Dah Sung
(李達生) alias Tseng Yi Ming (鄭一鳴) to assassinate
General Hsu Kuo Liang, the late Chief of the Woosung-
Shanghai Constabulary, while he (Wang) fled from
Shanghai to an unknown destination immediately after the
crime. The murder of General Hsu Kuo Liang was
attributed to a squabble between General Chi Hsueh Yuan
of Kiangsu Province and General Ho Feng Ling of Chekiang.

王亚樵摘要
1936年12月12日。
王亚樵（Wang Yah Jao，王亚樵），年龄约50岁，安徽人，作为一名对多起政治谋杀案负责的臭名昭著的刺客而广为人知。据信他没有政治倾向，而是受某一方或多方雇佣实施恐怖主义行为。他的活动，尤其是近年来，对中央政府构成了持续的威胁，中央政府曾一度悬赏10万美元缉拿他。
除了他曾一度在冯玉祥将军手下担任低级军官外，人们对王亚樵早期的职业生涯知之甚少。虽然他的受教育程度低于他的某些受过大学教育的追随者，但他非常精明，头脑聪明，具备所有的领导素质。1923年11月7日，由王亚樵组织并担任主席的上海全国劳工救国会致电苏联驻北京代表，祝贺其国家解放周年纪念日，并邀请其来上海签署中苏商业条约以促进两国友谊，王亚樵由此首次引起当地警方的注意。仅仅几天后，即1923年11月10日，王亚樵指派其追随者李达生（Lee Dah Sung），别名郑一鸣（Tseng Yi Ming），刺杀前淞沪警察厅长徐国梁将军，而他（王）在犯罪后立即逃离上海，去向不明。徐国梁将军的被杀归咎于江苏省齐燮元将军与浙江省何丰林将军之间的争执。

Wang's whereabouts and activities at that time were
the subjects of police enquiries for a considerable
period.

In March, 1923 the nature of Wang Yah Jao's
activities and ambition was revealed in a telegram
dispatched to the Civil & Military Governors of Chekiang
by General Ma Li Kyih, Military Governor of Anhwei
Province, alleging that Wang was recruiting soldiers in
Suchow. Wang immediately refuted the above accusation
by dispatching a telegram to General Ma, which was
published in the local papers, stating that he had been
ill for the past three months and had not left Shanghai
during that period. It was absolutely absurd to say,
Wang continued, that he was recruiting soldiers in
Suchow. Wang, however, warned the Governor not to do
further harm to Anhwei province and its people.

Police made exhaustive enquiries but failed to
confirm Wang's statement that he was in Shanghai, and it
was later reported that he had been given command of a
detachment of soldiers in Hangchow, apparently to reward
him for his part in the murder of General Hsu Kuo Liang.

Under his direction his followers murdered Mr. Chao
Tih Jao(趙鐵橋), late Managing Director of the China
Merchants' Steam Navigation Company on 24.7.1930,
political motive being again the cause of the crime.
Wang Zeh Chao(王澤潮), brother of Wang Yah Jao, a
lawyer practising in Shanghai, was arrested by the S.M.P.
in 1933 in connection with the crime and was subsequently
handed over to the Chinese Authorities in connection
with another case.

The attempt on the life of Minister T.V. Soong and
the murder of his secretary at the North Railway Station
during July, 1931 was also the work of Wang Yah Jao and
his followers. He also planned to assassinate members

当时王亚樵的行踪和活动是警方长期调查的主题。

1923年3月，安徽省督军马联甲（Ma Li Kyih，音译）向浙江军民长官发送的一份电报揭示了王亚樵活动的性质和野心，指控王在苏州招募士兵。王立即通过向马将军发送一份在当地报纸上刊登的电报驳斥了上述指控，称他在过去三个月里一直生病，期间未曾离开上海。王继续说道，说他在苏州招募士兵完全是荒谬的。然而，王警告督军不要再进一步损害安徽省及其人民的利益。

警方进行了详尽的调查，但未能证实王关于他在上海的说法，后来有报道称他在杭州被任命指挥一支分队，这显然是对他参与谋杀徐国梁将军的奖赏。

在他的指使下，其追随者于1930年7月24日谋杀了招商局前总经理赵铁桥先生（Mr. Chao Tih Jao），政治动机再次成为犯罪的原因。王亚樵的兄弟、在上海执业的律师王泽潮（Wang Zeh Chao）于1933年因该案被上海公共租界工部局警务处逮捕，随后因另一案件被移交给中国当局。

1931年7月，在北站企图刺杀宋子文部长并谋杀其秘书的行为也是王亚樵及其追随者所为。他还计划刺杀成员

of the Enquiry Mission, detailed by the League of
Nations in connection with the Manchurian Incident,
and that the plot was frustrated was due only to the
close surveillance and extra protection afforded by
the S.M.P. This fact was borne out by the statements
made by certain prisoners whose arrests were effected
by the S.M.P. in 1933.
During the Sino-Japanese hostilities in 1932,
Wang was active in the formation of volunteer units in
Shanghai to assist the 19th Route Army, but his activities
were in reality still operating against the Central
Government.
Wang, realising that his capture was eagerly sought
by the Central Government, solicited support from General
Chen Ming Chu, the leader at that time of the Fukien
Peoples' Government, and he became a close follower of
the said general and acted in accordance with his
instructions. Wang is also reported to have been the
Chief of the Special Affairs Section the "Productive
Party", an organisation which was similar to the Chinese
Communist Party.
When arrests were made in Nanking and Shanghai in
connection with the attempt on the life of Mr. Wang
Ching Wei, it then transpired that Wang Yah Jao had again
played the major part in the plot. Enquiries showed
that during the latter part of 1935, Wang, apparently
acting on the instructions of Chen Ming Chu and after
having had several meetings with his followers in Hongkong,
detailed Hwa Ke Ts(華克之), his right hand man, Tsang
Yu Hwa(張玉華) alias Tsang Ts Ming(張子明), Ho Po Kwang
(賀波光), Sung Feng Ming (孫鳳鳴) etc. to go to
Shanghai and Nanking and to devise ways and means to
get rid of either General Chiang Kai Shek or Mr. Wang
Ching Wei or both. Posing as a reporter of the Cheng

国联为处理满洲事变而派遣的调查团，以及该阴谋之所以被挫败， solely 归功于上海公共租界工部局警务处（S.M.P.）的严密监视和额外保护。这一事实得到了1933年被上海公共租界工部局警务处逮捕的某些囚犯的供词证实。
在1932年的中日敌对行动期间，王某积极在上海组建志愿部队以协助第十九路军，但其活动实际上仍在反对中央政府。
王某意识到中央政府正急切地想要抓捕他，便向当时福建人民政府的领导人陈铭枢将军寻求支持，成为该将军的亲信并按照其指示行事。据报，王某还是“生产党”特别事务科科长，该组织类似于中国共产党。
当南京和上海因汪精卫先生遇刺案而进行逮捕时，真相大白，王亚樵再次在阴谋中扮演了主要角色。调查显示，在1935年下半年，王某显然按照陈铭枢的指示，在与香港的追随者多次会面后，派遣其亲信华克之、张玉华（别名张子明）、贺波光、孙凤鸣等人前往上海和南京，策划除掉蒋介石将军或汪精卫先生，或两者兼除的方法。孙凤鸣伪装成《晨光通讯社》记者……

Kwang News Agency, Sung Peng Ling gained entry to the
premises where the 5th Plenary Session was in progress,
and in the absence of General Chiang Kai Shek, fired at
and seriously wounded Mr. Wang Ching Wei which caused
him to retire from political life for some time. Sung
was shot down by the bodyguards and subsequently died
of his injuries.
Though the Police had every reason to believe that
Wang Yah Jao was behind a series of murders of Japanese
sailors and civilians between 1935 and 1936, they were
unable to confirm their supposition until arrests were
made in connection with the Kayau Murder case which took
place on Chi Mei Road on 10.7.36. The prisoners in
this case told the police that they were hired by Hwa
Ke Ts, who in turn received instructions from Wang
Yah Jao to carry out their premeditated plan. The
pistol used in the murder of Kayau was later recovered
by the police with the assistance of one of the
prisoners.
The close connection between Wang Yah Jao and
Generals Chen King Chu and Li Chi Sen was also confirmed
by Tsang Yu Hwa alias Tsang Ts Ling, accused in connection
with the Mr. Wang Ching Wei case, who told the court in
Nanking that Wang received instructions from the above
generals to murder Mr. Wang Ching Wei.
At the end of November, 1936 local newspapers
carried reports to the effect that Wang Yah Jao had been
murdered in Wuchow on November 21 by some unknown
assailants. It was rumoured that these assassins were
in the pay of the Government but reliable confirmation
of the report is, however, lacking.

尽管警方有充分理由相信王亚樵是1935年至1936年间一系列日本水兵和平民谋杀案的背后主使，但在与1936年7月10日发生在集美路的加藤（Kayau）谋杀案有关的逮捕行动之前，他们无法证实这一推测。此案的囚犯告诉警方，他们是受华克之雇佣，而华克之则是从王亚樵那里接受指令来执行其预谋计划的。用于谋杀加藤的手枪后来在一名囚犯的协助下被警方找回。
王亚樵与陈京楚（音译）将军和李济深将军之间的密切关系也得到了证实，这是由涉及汪精卫先生案件的被告张玉华（别名张子明/张子凌(音译)）确认的，他在南京法庭上称，王某是从上述将军那里接受刺杀汪精卫先生的指令。
1936年11月底，当地报纸刊登报道，称王亚樵于11月21日在梧州被一些不明身份的袭击者谋杀。有谣言称这些刺客受政府雇用，但该报道缺乏可靠的证实。

THE SHANGHAI TIMES, THURSDAY, NOVEMBER 26, 1936
17761

Notorious
Gang Chief
Shot Down

Secret Society Leader
Slain While Leaving
Woman's Residence

CANTON, Nov. 25.—Death caught up with Wang Ya-hsiao, leader of Hung Shun Hui, notorious secret society, as he was about to leave the home of a woman-friend, at Wuchow, Kwangsi Province, late last Saturday night.
Riddled with bullets and dagger wounds, the body of China's "Public Enemy No. 1", was found by policemen rushing to the scene of the shooting.
The gunmen and Wang's hostess for the night had fled before the arrival of the police.
Wang, who was 53 years old, was credited by the police of various cities in China with having been the "brains" behind the attempted assassination of Mr. Wang Ching-wei, former President of the Executive Yuan in Nanking last November, and was suspected of the murder of Mr. Kosaku Kayau, a Japanese salesman, on Chimei Road, in Chapei, this summer.
From his headquarters in Hongkong, Wang directed the activities of various gangs in South China and along the Yangtze Valley.
Of late, Wang was closely identified with elements formerly affiliated with the Nineteenth Route Army and the Social Democratic Chinese Racial Revolutionary Union.

"Secret Service Agents"
This led to the belief here that the assassins were secret service agents in the pay of the Nanking government, which Wang and his recent associates were seeking to embarrass by murdering Japanese residents in China.
The Hung Shun Hui, or Abundance of Luck Society, is generally said to have originated from the Hung League, the known history of which can be traced as far back as 1662.
The League was formed in the south and later extended to all parts of China, especially along the Yangtze Valley.
The Hung Shun Hui was patterned along the lines of the League, like many other secret societies affiliated with the original League. Though at first brought into being as organizations for the mutual aid of members, some of these degenerated into vicious gangs.
The Hung League is one of the best known secret societies in China.—Domei.

17761

臭名昭著的
帮会头目
被击毙

秘密社团首领
在离开女子住所时
被杀

广州，11月25日电——上周六深夜，当臭名昭著的秘密社团洪顺会首领王亚樵准备离开广西梧州一位女性朋友的家时，死神降临。
这位中国的“第一号公敌”身中数弹并遭刀刺，尸体被赶至枪击现场的警察发现。
枪手和王当晚的女主人已在警察到达前逃离。
现年53岁的王某，被中国各地警方认为是去年11月在南京企图刺杀前行政院院长汪精卫先生的“幕后智囊”，并被怀疑于今年夏天在闸北集美路谋杀了日本推销员加藤功（Kosaku Kayau）。
王某以香港为总部，指挥华南及长江流域各帮派的活动。
最近，王某与前第十九路军及中国社会民主党人种族革命联盟的成员关系密切。

“特务人员”
这导致此地人们认为，刺客是南京政府雇用的特务人员，王某及其最近的同伙试图通过在中国谋杀日本居民来使南京政府难堪。
洪顺会，即洪福会，据称一般起源于洪门，其已知历史可追溯至1662年。
该联盟在南方成立，后来扩展到中国各地，特别是沿长江流域。
洪顺会的模式仿照洪门，如同许多隶属于原始洪门的秘密社团一样。虽然起初是作为成员互助组织而建立，但其中一些已堕落为恶毒的帮派。
洪门是中国最著名的秘密社团之一。——同盟社

The Shanghai Evening Post & Mercury, Wednesday, December 2, 1936

General Shot
For Plotting

Wang Assassination
Suspect Betrayed
By Pretty Girl

CANTON, Nov. 27.—Suspected
of being the chief instigator in
the attempts to kill Mr. Wang
Ching-wei last December, Brig.-
General Wang Ya-ch'iao was shot
in Wuchow following a dinner
party in which a pretty woman
from Hongkong was involved, ac-
cording to messages from Wu-
chow.

Efforts were made by the Nan-
king police to apprehend Wang
Ya-ch'iao but somehow he eluded
arrest by staying in Hongkong
and Macao, away from Chinese
jurisdiction. He lived in Kwangsi
for several months and took up
residence in Wuchow five months
ago, although his movements were
watched by secret agents since his
arrival at the city.

The murder was committed at
11 p.m. November 21, when Gen-
eral Wang was guest of a lady
friend who arrived there from
Hongkong on November 17. Five
shots were fired by unknown as-
sailants, and three of them fatal-
ly wounded Wang. After the
shooting the mysterious woman
disappeared. The scene of the
killing is in 14 Tai Tung Central
Street, rented by Wang on behalf
of the woman.

Hongkong banknotes to the value
of several hundred dollars and
jewellery were left in the house.
The Wuchow police believe that
the motive of the murder is
political. The actual assassin of
Mr. Wang Ching-wei was killed
after the attempted assassination,
but Wang Ya-ch'iao is suspected
of being the master mind of the
plot.

将军因
策划阴谋
被枪杀

汪精卫遇刺案
嫌疑人被
美女出卖

广州，11月27日电——据梧州消息，涉嫌是去年12月企图杀害汪精卫先生的主要煽动者的王亚樵少将，在梧州参加完一场涉及一位来自香港的美女的晚宴后被枪杀。

南京警方曾试图逮捕王亚樵，但他 somehow 通过留在香港和澳门，避开中国司法管辖范围，从而逃脱了逮捕。他在广西居住了几个月，并于五个月前搬至梧州居住，尽管自抵达该市以来，他的行踪一直受到特务的监视。

谋杀发生于11月21日晚上11点，当时王将军是一位女士朋友的客人，该女士于11月17日从香港抵达。不明身份的袭击者开了五枪，其中三枪致命地击中了王某。枪击发生后，这位神秘女子失踪了。凶案现场位于大东中路14号，由王某为该女子租用。

屋内留下了价值数百美元的港币钞票和珠宝。梧州警方认为谋杀动机是政治性的。刺杀汪精卫先生的实际刺客在未遂刺杀后被杀，但王亚樵被怀疑是该阴谋的主谋。

November 26, 1936. Morning Translation.

NICHI-NICHI

WONG AH CHIAO MURDERED AT WUCHOW

A special telegram from Canton
dated November 25 reports that at 11 p.m. November 21 Wong
Ah Chiao, the leader of an anti-Japanese gang, was murdered
at a house on Great Eastern Road, Wuchow, Kwangsi Province.
The house was occupied by a Chinese woman, Wong's friend.
Wong was invited to dinner at the house. At the close
of the dinner three or four men fired at Wong, who was struck
by three bullets. He was also stabbed twice. Wong died
instantly. The Peace Preservation Corps dispatched officers
to the scene but the assassins and the occupant of the
house had already decamped.

S.I.C. ACCEPTS ECONOMY COMMITTEE'S REPORT

It is reported that at a special
meeting held on the afternoon of November 25, the S.I.C.
decided to accept the Economy Committee's report. Six
months notice will be given to the staff. The Economy
Committee's report will be published in the Municipal
Gazette on November 27.

Sir,

Inquiries have been made into the origin and accuracy of a report alleging that Wong Yah Zau (王亞樵) has been in Shanghai for the past three months which appeared in the Chinese newspaper Ming Kuo Pao in the issue of March 26, 1924. Wong Yah Zau (王亞樵) was the promoter of a society known as the Citizens Committee the headquarters of which are at 8 Johnstone Road (局門路), near St. Catherine's Bridge, Chinese territory. He recently sent a letter which cannot be obtained from Chekiang to Zoo Sih Ling (徐錫麟), promoter of the defunct Poetung Weavers' Union and a prominent member of the Citizens' Committee. Zoo Sih Ling ordered his secretary, Zung Tsoong Zeu (陳忠壽) to draft a letter to be sent to local newspapers for publication. Zung Tsoong Zeu wrote a letter (attached) in such a way as to make it appear that it was written by Wong Yah Zau and sent it to the Tung Han News Agency, 7 Shantung Road. The news agency in turn circulated the letter to all local Chinese newspapers but only two viz: The Ming Kuo Pao and the National Herald published it. The person, therefore, who is responsible for the attached article is Zung Tsoong Zeu (陳忠壽) and there is not much doubt Wong Yah Zau is somewhere in Chekiang province. Originals of letter sent by Zung Tsoong Zeu to Tung Han News Agency and draft sent by Tung Han News Agency to local newspapers attached.

1. Official cause. The Nankin Tuchun had every

以下是南京督军代表在谋杀案发生约十五天后在上海提供的关于许国梁 (Hsu Kuo Liang) 死因的一种说法：-

1. 官方原因。南京督军对许国梁将军的忠诚充满信任；委托他执行最机密性质的任务，包括逮捕与当地军阀友好的国民党人。众所周知，是齐燮元将军 (General Chi) 建议授予许国梁元帅头衔，并且同一位将军还推荐他担任警察总监，以便他的级别与何丰林将军 (General Ho) 平级，且无需听从何将军的命令。这一提议不仅引起了何将军的嫉妒，而且被认为在浙江与江苏爆发战争时构成严重危险，因为届时许国梁将有可能危及当地军事长官的地位，后者曾多次试图罢免许国梁但未成功，因为许得到南京方面的支持。

私人原因。
得知南京将在上海或吴淞设立办事处以制止武器和鸦片走私，何将军认为这是对其管辖权的侵犯，于是他在吴淞设立了这样一个办事处，该办事处运作了约六个月，名为“松沪查禁私运违禁品处”。

The Director was a man named Woo 吴 , recommended
by Van Yu Ling, Chief of Staff to Tupan Lu Yung Ziang
of Che-jiang. Instead of putting a stop to the smuggling,
Wu, who was himself a smuggler, with the assistance of
Du Yu Sun杜玉蓀 an assistant of Det. Huang Ching Tung
of the French Police, Chiang Siao Lien 張嘯連, a
notorious loafer of Frenchtown, organised a Company
for the special purpose of smuggling opium by means
of steam launches and motors. Two fifths of the proceeds
went to the Military Governor's yamen, two fifths
to the loafers in Frenchtown and one fifth to
the Hangchow authorities. The money earmarked for the
Governor's staff is alleged to have been paid to
Chief of Staff Vaung, who is also Commander of the
Woosung forts, and Lu Dah Chuen, Secretary in English,
the daily income being estimated roughly at about $1,000.
This had been going on for a long time. Then a dispute
arose over the division of money. General Chen Loh Sen
of the 4th Division, Hangchow, became aware of this and
he organised the smuggling separately using armed soldiers.
Hsu Kuo Liang knew all this and it is stated that he had
a quarrel with Chief of Staff Wong in a brothel and both nearly
came to blows. Vaung is alleged to have threatened Hsu
Kuo Liang with death or removal but as Hsu was a man who
never cared about threats he did not report to General
Chi or Civil Governor Han. It is a well known fact
that General Hsu did not receive any money on opium
smuggling.

主任是一名姓吴 (Woo) 的人，由浙江督军卢永祥 (Lu Yung Ziang) 的参谋长范余龄 (Van Yu Ling) 推荐。吴非但没有制止走私，反而作为一名走私者，在法国警察黄景桐侦探的助手杜玉蓀 (Du Yu Sun)、法租界 notorious 流氓张啸连 (Chiang Siao Lien) 的协助下，组织了一家公司，专门利用汽艇和汽车走私鸦片。收益的五分之二归督军衙门，五分之二归法租界的流氓，五分之一归杭州当局。据称，拨给督军幕僚的钱款支付给了参谋长方本仁 (Vaung，音译)，他也是吴淞炮台司令，以及英文秘书陆达泉 (Lu Dah Chuen，音译)，每日收入估计约为1,000美元。这种情况已持续很长时间。随后，因分钱问题发生争执。杭州第四师师长陈乐山 (Chen Loh Sen) 得知此事，便单独组织武装士兵进行走私。许国梁知晓这一切，据说他曾在妓院与参谋长王某 (Wong，音译) 发生争吵，双方几乎动手。据称方本仁 (Vaung) 曾威胁要杀死或罢免许国梁，但由于许国梁是一个从不畏惧威胁的人，他并未向齐燮元将军或民政长韩国钧 (Han) 报告。众所周知的事实是，许将军并未从鸦片走私中收取任何钱财。

Questioned in regard to the ap-
pointment of a Director of Shang-

said that this was a matter which

and its cause was an open secret,
continued Marshal Chi. Gen. Hsu
was in the way of a gang of
official opium smugglers. He
tried to stop the smuggling but
met with little success. In fact,
his efforts to expose those con-
nected with the affair resulted in
his death. He managed, however,
to report the affairs of this
official gang to the Civil Governor
just before his death and made it
plain that those in charge of the
affairs of the gang wanted the

attention to the fact that Gen.

在被问及继已故许国梁将军之后任命上海和吴淞华捕督察一事时，齐燮元元帅表示，此事由江苏省民政长韩国钧先生控制。齐燮元元帅继续说道，许国梁将军的死及其原因是一个公开的秘密。许将军妨碍了一伙官方鸦片走私者的利益。他试图制止走私，但收效甚微。事实上，他揭露涉案人员的努力导致了他的死亡。然而，他在死前设法将这伙官方团伙的事务报告给了民政长，并明确指出，负责该团伙事务的人想要将钱用于战争目的，并想要谋杀他。如果没有这笔鸦片走私收入，他们将无法进行战争。齐燮元元帅提请注意这样一个事实：杀害许将军的凶手仍然活着，且未受到公开审判。
